name: @pipeworx/mcp-minnesota-code

tools.name: mn_statute
tools.description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Minnesota Statutes — Minnesota state law — by citation. "Minn. Stat. 609.185" is first degree murder. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does Minn. Stat. 609.185 say" or to check a statute a case relies on.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-minnesota-code forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the minnesota-code pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
